task: Judge only one fixed PET human-annotated activity-flow ordering property on a synthetic sequential BPMN candidate containing exactly two tasks and one complete start-to-end path.
exclusions: Not an independent re-annotation of PET
split: Deterministic source-document hash; 9 validation and 36 held-out test documents. Both variants of one document remain in the same split.
counterexamples: Exactly one positive and one deterministically reversed negative candidate per source document; the negative is verified by construction for the single selected flow-order property only.

ablation.note: E1 requests a bounded observable review and concise evidence, not hidden chain-of-thought.

evidenceValidation: A pass/fail is downgraded to unknown unless the evidence cites at least one BPMN identifier and every cited Task/Flow/Start/End identifier exists in the submitted candidate.

decoding.seedReason: Not supported by both selected endpoints.

scopeLimitations: Conclusions apply only to the selected activity-to-activity flow-order property on a sequential two-task BPMN candidate with one complete path.
This does not establish correctness of the source PET process, a generated BPMN process as a whole, arbitrary BPMN control flow, requirement extraction quality, or natural Text2BPMN error prevalence.
Positive and reversed candidates are constructed fixtures, not a representative sample of generated Text2BPMN outputs.
costReporting: Total cost is the sum of costs reported in saved API usage metadata, not independently verified billed cost. Three of 720 calls lack effective model, provider, and cost metadata; unknown cost is not treated as zero.
uncertainty: See uncertainty.json: offline paired document-cluster bootstrap over 36 held-out documents; both candidate variants remain together per draw. Intervals describe this finite benchmark sample and are not evidence of population-wide superiority or statistical significance.
